title: Raksha Rajya Mantri Attends Closing Ceremony of All India Sainik Schools National Games 2026 at Sainik School Bijapur
body_text: Raksha Rajya Mantri (RRM) Shri Sanjay Seth graced the closing ceremony of the All India Sainik Schools National Games (AISSNG) 2026 as the Chief Guest at Sainik School Bijapur on November 07, 2026. He presented medals and trophies to the winning teams, recognising their outstanding achievements and dedication. Sainik School Ghorakhal emerged as the champion in Junior Boys' Basketball, while Vikasa Sainik School secured the Junior Girls' Basketball title. Sainik School Amaravatinagar won the Junior Boys' Volleyball championship. Sainik School Jhansi won the Debate Championship, while Sainik School Kapurthala emerged victorious in the Quiz Competition. “Keep pushing your limits, never give up and stay hungry for excellence,” addressing the young cadets, Chief of the Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan encouraged the participants to strive for excellence. He fondly recalled his formative years at Sainik School Bijapur and acknowledged the institution's invaluable contribution to shaping his personality and achievements. The AISSNG organised between 03-07 November 2026 emerged as a vibrant platform for national integration, cultural exchange and mutual understanding. It provided students from different regions an opportunity to exchange knowledge, cultures, languages, beliefs and ideas, while fostering lasting friendships, camaraderie and a shared sense of national pride. The colourful closing ceremony was attended by an eminent gathering of serving and retired defence officers, ministers, public representatives and senior administrators. **** SR/Ruchi
